# runzero Provider

Interact with the RunZero platform API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_token` (String, Sensitive) RunZero Account API token (CT prefix). Can also be set via RUNZERO_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.
- `api_url` (String) RunZero API base URL. Defaults to https://console.runzero.com/api/v1.0. Can also be set via RUNZERO_API_URL.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) RunZero OAuth2 client ID. Can also be set via RUNZERO_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) RunZero OAuth2 client secret. Can also be set via RUNZERO_CLIENT_SECRET.
- `org_token` (String, Sensitive) RunZero Organization API token (OT prefix). Can also be set via RUNZERO_ORG_TOKEN.
